problem: OIDC-authenticated MCP deploy returned success while Netlify current production remained on an older deploy, leaving exact-SHA readback blocked.
root_cause: The delivery chain relied on direct MCP deployment after a Git-linked push miss. A direct MCP deploy can complete without proving that the linked production branch was rebuilt and published.
prevention: After the bounded Git-linked wait, trigger a linked-repository Netlify build for branch main through the GitHub-OIDC bridge before using direct MCP deployment.
The OIDC bridge keeps the Netlify proxy credential server-side and returns only bounded build/deploy metadata.
If the linked build reaches the exact expected SHA, stop without a second side effect.
Only if Git-linked and linked-build delivery both fail may the MCP deploy fallback run.
Exact release.json SHA, production context, pricing content and pricing/i18n browser proof remain mandatory before LIVE_BEWEZEN.

evidence.symptom: MCP deploy step success while exact production identity stayed pending
